title: Add remote installer update

context.summary: Implement signed remote release update from the installer.
context.background: Installed systems must be able to download, verify, stage, apply and rollback release updates.

in: Download signed release metadata and artifacts to staging.
Verify signatures and checksums before applying assets.
Backup current config/state before migrations and asset swap.
Restart services and healthcheck the updated stack.
Rollback to previous release on failed migration or healthcheck.

acceptance_criteria: Installer can update from a remote signed release source.
Failed verification stops before changing runtime assets.
Failed migration or healthcheck restores the previous release assets.
Update journal records each step and rollback result.

manual_checks: Confirm update never deletes existing backups during rollback.

risks: Migration rollback must be conservative and clearly document manual recovery if schema downgrade is unsafe.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
